name: @aparte/svelte
description: Svelte wrapper for aparté — an ergonomic <AparteChat> component plus stores over the framework-agnostic web components. Works on Svelte 4 and 5.
//packaging: svelte-package copies the .svelte components and compiles the .ts to .js; tsc emits index.d.ts.
Both are needed: a Svelte library must ship its components (the `svelte` condition) AND a real
JS entry (a bundler that does not add that condition still resolves `default`).
FIXED: dist/AparteChat.svelte.d.ts and dist/AparteUi.svelte.d.ts are now emitted, so a consumer's
tsc/svelte-check DOES see the components' real prop/event/slot types. The earlier note here was
wrong about the cause: svelte2tsx WAS resolvable from @sveltejs/package (it is a direct, non-peer
dependency of @sveltejs/package itself). The real cause, found by toggling each candidate setting
alone against a real `svelte-package --tsconfig <probe>` invocation: this package's real
tsconfig.json inherits `noEmitOnError: true` from the repo base, which silently blocks
svelte2tsx's `emitDts` step on diagnostics that are EXPECTED noise in its `dts` transform mode
(svelte2tsx's own diagnostic filter already excludes those exact codes as non-fatal). `composite`
is NOT a cause in either direction (verified the same way) and is left untouched.
reason documented there) and is passed via `--tsconfig` in the build script below; the real
`tsc -b` pass is untouched by it. Verified against a consumer `tsc --noEmit` importing the built
package: a wrong AparteChat prop now errors.

scripts.build: svelte-package -i src/lib -o dist --tsconfig ./tsconfig.dts.json && tsc -b --emitDeclarationOnly --force && node scripts/strip-dist-tests.mjs
